title: MCP Operational Readiness
description: Verifies performance, stability, and resource behavior under load

checks.title: Handles 2 concurrent requests
checks.description: Latency and error rate stable at concurrency=2

checks.title: Handles 8 concurrent requests
checks.description: Latency and error rate stable at concurrency=8

checks.title: Handles 32 concurrent requests
checks.description: Server remains responsive at higher concurrency (may degrade but not fail)

checks.title: 30-minute soak test passes
checks.description: No memory leaks, crashes, or error rate increases over 30 minutes

checks.title: Memory stays within bounds
checks.description: Peak RSS doesn't exceed configured ceiling

checks.title: CPU stays within bounds
checks.description: Sustained CPU doesn't exceed configured ceiling

checks.title: Handles request flood gracefully
checks.description: Under burst traffic, server rejects excess rather than queuing unboundedly

checks.title: Handles sustained overload
checks.description: At sustained RPS above capacity, server remains stable

checks.title: Recovers from crash
checks.description: After SIGKILL, server restarts cleanly without data corruption

checks.title: Handles crash during request
checks.description: Client detects server death mid-request and can recover

checks.title: P99 latency within SLA
checks.description: 99th percentile latency stays under configured threshold
